messages:
Maria: Hey team — quick proposal for next week's weekly triage. Can we try a short end-of-day (EOD) 30m slot at 16:00 on Wednesdays for two weeks? Goal: reduce context-switches during mornings and make the meeting strictly owner-driven.

Sam: EOD works for some, but APAC folks will be late. Is alternating Weds/Thurs an option? :thinking_face:

Lee: Alternating could help. Also +1 to 30m if we keep a strict agenda and pre-read.

Devon: What if we split into a 20m quick lane sweep + 10m optional deep-dive? Keeps it tight and adds runway for one heavier issue.

Taylor: I can run the first two sessions and enforce the 20/10 split. I suggest this agenda: 1) quick metrics (2m), 2) new regressions & triage (12m), 3) owner pings & handoffs (6m), 4) optional deep-dive (up to 10m).

Maria: Nice. Would like to try alternating weeks: Week A = 16:00 Wed (Americas-friendly), Week B = 09:00 Thu (APAC-friendly). Rotate owners accordingly. Thoughts?

Sam: Alternating schedule = +1. Practical ask: can we update calendar description to include the lanes and a `pre-read` checklist?

Lee: Agreed. Minimal pre-read: link to backlog query + top 3 flaky tests + any new customer-facing regression. Put links in the invite.

Devon: Quick poll idea: React with :thumbsup: for 16:00 Wed only, :clock10: for alternating, :thumbsdown: to keep current (no change). I'll tally by EOD.

Taylor: I'll draft the invite text. Draft below — feel free to edit before I send: 

```
Weekly Triage (20m sweep + 10m optional deep-dive)
Cadence: Alternating Weds 16:00 / Thurs 09:00 (trial 4 weeks)
Pre-read (required): backlog filter link; top 3 flaky tests; regression notes (if any)
Agenda:
 - Metrics & alerts (2m)
 - New regressions / hot bugs (12m)
 - Owner pings & assignments (6m)
 - Optional deep-dive (10m)
Rules: Owners only for items in assignment column; non-owners post async notes.
```

Maria: Looks good. Add a note: ‘If you can’t attend, update the owner field in the ticket before the meeting.’

Sam: Also request: keep the recording for 2 weeks and the meeting notes in the triage doc (so folks can scan).

sched-bot: Calendar invite prepared (trial placeholder). Invite body link: https://calendar.redwood.example/triage-eod-trial

Devon: Quick reminder — please react to the poll (:+1: / :clock10: / :-1:) so I can finalize schedule by EOD.

Taylor: I'll send the invite after poll. If alternating passes, I’ll add a rotation column in the triage board for Week A/B owners.

Maria: Thanks everyone — appreciate quick responses. We’ll decide today and roll out next week. :rocket:
